round:
Use case: ui-mockup / product-mockup.
Create a visually self-explanatory SIX PANEL storyboard, 3 columns by 2 rows, illustrating ONE complete round of BOX RUN on a practical homemade crypto game handheld. User does not read long text: communicate through clear pictures, arrows, hand gestures and tiny captions only. Wide landscape board, beautiful crisp game art and believable FDM 3D printed hardware. No paragraphs, no decorative slogans.
CONSISTENT DEVICE across ALL six panels: entirely WHITE matte FDM printed rectangular handheld, flat chamfered face, charcoal painted screen surround, a landscape 3:2 color screen occupying upper portion, EXACTLY TWO round buttons grouped at lower LEFT: RED button on LEFT and YELLOW button on RIGHT; no lettering required on button caps. Small white rotary KNOB on RIGHT side lower down, NO crank, NO screws, NO extra button. Small neatly cut dark tape tab at each lower side seam, no tape over screen or controls. Same front three-quarter camera angle across panels, large screens, white plain background. Cropped hand/fingertip in first 4 panels to make interaction clear, device still fully readable.
GAME: dark navy background, simple CREAM price trace, ETH diamond marker, YELLOW outlined rectangular target range at RIGHT with a vertical expiry marker, AMBER timer. Very large pixels, clean sparse screen, no trading dashboard, no tiny numbers. All rounds explicitly practice: small readable "DEMO" in screen corner.
Panel 1 caption "1 / AIM": fingers turning side knob, curved rotation arrow. On screen yellow target box at right with vertical up/down arrow to show moving target relative to price trail on left. Show 20s at top.
Panel 2 caption "2 / SIZE": fingertip pressing YELLOW front button, inset curved arrow at knob. On screen same target grows vertically using two ghost outlines and outward arrows; bigger box / smaller box visually clear. Single small potential-return label "2.0x".
Panel 3 caption "3 / LOCK": fingertip presses YELLOW button. Screen becomes clean confirmation card with EXACT three lines "10 CREDITS", "20s", "RETURN 20" and small target preview. Bottom tiny "YELLOW: LOCK". Red button clearly available for back. No currency signs.
Panel 4 caption "4 / WATCH": hands no longer touching buttons or knob. Screen cream price trail now extends near target, same yellow box fixed in place, very large "03" countdown. A small lock icon on target conveys no changing bet.
Panel 5 caption "5 / HIT": same game reaches expiry INSIDE yellow target, ETH diamond visibly inside box; target now mint, small pixel confetti around it and huge "HIT" above, lower line "+10 NET". Show the moment graphically, not just text.
Panel 6 caption "6 / AGAIN": result screen shows balance "110 CREDITS" and two big color-coded in-screen prompts: RED "HOME", YELLOW "AGAIN". Red left physical button and yellow right physical button clearly match choices. A small ghosted previous target/trace behind result provides continuity.
HEADER ONLY "BOX RUN" and small subtitle "TURN. LOCK. WATCH."
FOOTER ONLY "PRACTICE GAME CONCEPT".
Make storyboard elegant, easy to understand without reading, charming and camera-friendly. Avoid all extra filler text, illegible microtype, complex charts, metallic hardware, fabricated winnings in dollars, additional controls. Render each screen large enough to understand.
outcomes: Use case: ui-mockup. An extremely clear visual explanation of the crypto prediction game BOX RUN, consisting of TWO LARGE landscape game screen closeups side by side. No hardware. Warm white margin and background. Top title only "WHERE WILL ETH LAND?" Left panel heading "INSIDE = HIT", right heading "OUTSIDE = MISS". Both screens 3:2 landscape aspect, dark navy background, LARGE chunky cream pixel price line traveling left to right, a rectangular target range occupying right quarter, vertical dashed expiry line passing through middle of rectangle. Little ETH diamond at final observed price exactly ON the expiry line. In LEFT screen final diamond is clearly INSIDE the MINT rectangle, big "HIT" and "+10 CREDITS", a few small pixel stars. In RIGHT screen final diamond is clearly ABOVE and OUTSIDE the amber rectangle, big "MISS" and "-10 CREDITS", no confetti. Clearly different price paths into two different outcomes. Faint sparse grid only, no axis numbers, no little labels, no city background. Screen corners small "DEMO". Under both screens show two simple large physical button symbols, red circle labeled BACK and yellow circle labeled AGAIN. Footer "10 PRACTICE CREDITS / 20 SECOND ROUND". Sophisticated charming retro pixel arcade art, excellent legibility, minimal text, no decorative slogans, no dollar signs. This is a conceptual practice payout illustration, not live transactions.
